name: David Mordekhov
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Issaquah, Washington
about: Attorney David Mordekhov represents injured clients in Injury Law Group NW, located in Issaquah, Washington. His practice focuses on advocating for individuals who have suffered injuries due to the negligence of others, with experience handling cases involving motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, construction accidents, traumatic brain injuries, trucking accidents and premises liability. He is committed to helping clients pursue fair compensation while guiding them through the legal process with diligence and personalized representation.

Admitted to practice law in Washington in 2002, Mr. Mordekhov has devoted his legal career to representing plaintiffs in complex personal injury litigation. His practice encompasses a variety of claims arising from serious accidents and catastrophic injuries, including those involving commercial vehicles, unsafe property conditions and construction sites. Through a client-centered approach, he works to protect the rights of injured individuals and their families while pursuing favorable outcomes through negotiation and litigation when necessary.

Mr. Mordekhov earned a Master of Laws from Peoples' Friendship Russian University before receiving his Juris Doctor from Seattle University School of Law in 2002. His educational background provides a strong legal foundation that supports his work in personal injury law and civil litigation.

In recognition of his professional accomplishments and ethical standards, Mr. Mordekhov has earned the AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, a distinction awarded to attorneys who demonstrate high levels of legal ability as evaluated by their peers.

Mr. Mordekhov remains active in the legal community through his membership in several professional organizations, including the Washington State Bar Association, the Washington Defense Trial Lawyers and the King County Bar Association. His ongoing involvement reflects his commitment to staying engaged with developments in the legal profession while continuing to advocate for clients throughout Washington.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
